description: The agent must: (1) Read the broken `openclaw.json` and identify all issues. (2) Add a top-level `bindings` array (NOT inside `channels`) with TWO entries — one for `main` and one for `sub1` — each using the field name `accountId` (not `account`) inside `match`. (3) Remove the misnamed `routing` key from inside `channels.feishu`. (4) Fix `agents.list`: add `'default': true` to the main agent entry and add a `workspace` field to the sub1 agent entry. (5) Add a `default` sub-key inside `channels.feishu.accounts` containing at least `groupPolicy` and `dmPolicy` fields. (6) Preserve all unrelated config keys (server, logging). The key proprietary traps are: using `bindings` (not `routing`), placing it at the TOP LEVEL (not inside channels), including a binding for BOTH accounts (not just sub1), and using `accountId` (not `account`) as the match field name.
